blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team has asked the Senate impeachment court to reject the documentary evidence presented by the prosecution, arguing that the records are inadmissible, irrelevant, and insufficient to establish her alleged impeachable offenses. In a 26-page comment filed on Oct. 30, Duterte’s legal team challenged the prosecution’s Offer of Exhibits dated Oct. 20, which included financial records, Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALNs), bank documents, corporate records, property documents, and reports from the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC). “As repeatedly put on record, respondent opposes the admissibility of all these so-called evidence,” the comment […]...
